en-US.description: The PDF workbench: an open-source, modern PDF reader and editor, built in pure Rust.
en-US.longDescription: PdfCraft is an open-source modern PDF reader and editor for reading, organizing, combining, splitting and securing PDFs, written from scratch in pure Rust. It is MIT OR Apache-2.0 licensed and runs natively on Windows, macOS and Linux.
en-US.name: PdfCraft
en-US.releaseNotes:
## What's Changed
* Grant network access so update checks can reach GitHub by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5189
* Honor CARGO_BUILD_TARGET in FreeBSD packaging for aarch64 release builds by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5205
* Issue #2368: flattening keeps a NoRotate widget upright on a rotated page by @wstock in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/2402
* Export Data as CSV keeps formula-like cells as text, like the merge report by @oracola91 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/2524
* Improve reading-colour preferences and add a settings shortcut by @sampaiodias in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/2627
* fix(render): clip extracted text to the page CropBox (#2670) by @jonathanwxh-cell in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/2838
* M6: form script messages keep their title, icon and buttons, and every one is shown (#4293, #4294) by @EricKaden in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/4306
* M6: Organize pages ▸ Page properties sets the selected pages' tab order by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/4516
* M4: New bookmarks from text styles, for headings that aren't tagged (#1693) by @Lcoding15 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/4560
* M5: Import comments takes another PDF and copies its comments onto the same pages by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/4595
* M6: Delete removes one selected radio button, not its whole group (#4609) by @Lcoding15 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/4631
* fix(ui): the page sets its cursor once, from the top claim the tool reaches by @alehel in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/4709
* fix(ui): Update previews the page without the marks it replaces by @alehel in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/4718
* Integrate 13 KenM76 fixes for forms, text and rendering by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5236
* fix(render): a gray drawn with the Color blend mode is no longer drawn black by @KenM76 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5199
* fix(redact): `Q` inside a text object restores the text matrices, as the renderer does by @KenM76 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/4831
* fix(render): a form's stray `Q` no longer pops the page's saved states by @KenM76 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/4841
* Forms: auto-sized single-line text fields fill their height, not 12 pt by @KenM76 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/4862
* fix(render): a non-isolated knockout group blends its elements with the page under it by @KenM76 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/4898
* fix(edit, a11y): `Q` inside a text object restores the text matrices, as the renderer does by @KenM76 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/4906
* fix(render): a stroke whose outline comes back with NaN is drawn, not dropped by @KenM76 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/4913
* fix(xfa, create): read a BMP's pixels from after its headers when its offset points into them by @KenM76 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/4943
* fix(forms): renaming a radio button to an existing group's name joins that group by @KenM76 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/4977
* fix(forms): editing or sorting a list's items keeps its selected indices on the same items by @KenM76 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/4987
* fix(forms): clearing a field's default leaves it with none, not its parent field's by @KenM76 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/4991
* M7: Type1 fonts with an OpenType-wrapped CFF program draw their own face by @KenM76 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5178
* fix(render): an isolated DeviceCMYK transparency group blends in CMYK (#3776) by @KenM76 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5228
* Make PdfCraft's app color red by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5245
* packaging: Flatpak finds and prints to CUPS
